Capacity (MW).note: A Uniper safety notice for the Ingolstadt plant, dated August 2022, gives Block 3 as 420 MW electric. The Bundesnetzagentur power plant list dated 26 June 2026 shows the row for Uniper Kraftwerke GmbH, Ingolstadt 3, with 420 MW gross capacity and 355 MW net capacity. GEM holds a figure that matches neither. The 420 MW figure is the gross nameplate, so it is the one GEM records.

City.note: The Uniper notice gives the plant address as Kraftwerk Ingolstadt, Bayernwerkstraße 30, 85098 Großmehring. So the plant sits in the municipality of Großmehring in the Eichstätt district, next to the city of Ingolstadt.
